title: Uswds paragraph components: This module provides a suite of Paragraphs bundles that works within the USWDS framework. (CVE-2026-114536)
description: The Drupal module 'uswds_paragraph_components' contains a vulnerability where its twig templates do not sufficiently sanitize values passed to markup. This issue affects versions prior to 3.1.3. Exploitation requires the attacker to have a role capable of editing content that uses the paragraph bundles provided by the module, which mitigates the risk. A patch is available to address this vulnerability.
aiSummary: The 'uswds_paragraph_components' Drupal module provides paragraph bundles within the USWDS framework. Its twig templates fail to properly sanitize input values before rendering markup, potentially allowing content injection or similar issues. However, exploitation is limited to users with content editing privileges for the affected paragraph bundles. Versions before 3.1.3 are affected, and a patch has been released to fix the sanitization flaw.
aiImpact: An attacker with content editing permissions could exploit the insufficient sanitization in the module's twig templates to inject unsafe markup, potentially leading to content injection issues. The impact is limited by the requirement that the attacker must already have a role that allows editing content using the vulnerable paragraph bundles.
